zh-CN.text:heroTitle:h1::0: 把长期主义，变成你的职业可能。
zh-CN.text:view-home:p:hero-lead:0: 从城市空间到商业服务，我们为愿意持续成长的人，提供多元业务、真实项目和清晰的长期发展通道。
zh-CN.text:benefits:p::2: Conduct diverse experiential activities and provide mental health-related training
zh-CN.text:benefits:p::3: Comprehensive medical coverage, annual medical subsidies and Wellness Dollars for personalized health choices
zh-CN.text:benefits:p::4: Organize all kinds of meaningful public welfare projects
zh-CN.text:benefits:p::5: Education subsidies and examination to support support further learning
zh-CN.text:benefits:p::6: Hipo Program and a suite of in-house learning and development programs to support long-term career progression
zh-CN.text:benefits:p::7: On-site visits to residential projects, retail destinations, and cultural landmarks.
zh-CN.text:stories:span::2: 启德体育园项目工程师
zh-CN.text:stories:blockquote::0: 作为一名退役运动员，我曾担心转行会面临困难。集团提供的运动员职业计划给了我机会。我的队友们指导我学习建筑基础知识。我在体育生涯中培养的毅力在这里备受重视，让我能够在全新的职业道路上大放异彩。
zh-CN.text:stories:blockquote::1: 在我入职的第一年，我就参与了文化策展项目。团队鼓励大胆的创新想法；即使是不完美的提案，也能在协作中不断完善，年轻的声音也得到充分倾听。
zh-CN.text:stories:blockquote::2: 当项目遇到障碍时，我们的首要任务是解决问题，而非推诿责任。我历经 12 年从一线员工逐步晋升，并在多个项目中获得了发展机会。
zh-CN.text:growth:p::2: 新世界发展为在校学生、应届毕业生及在职员工提供系统化的职业发展路径。我们的培养体系聚焦跨境实践历练、专业能力提升以及领导力培育，覆盖香港及大湾区。
zh-CN.text:growth:p::3: 我们为应届毕业生提供系统化领导力培训与导师辅导。参与者可获得跨部门项目实战经验，为未来担任管理岗位夯实基础。
zh-CN.text:growth:p::4: 我们的实习项目提供真实职场历练与专业指导。学生能够在实际商业项目中锻炼实操能力，建立行业认知。
zh-CN.text:growth:p::5: 我们助力员工持续职业发展。定期举办研习课程与技能提升资源，帮助人才增强综合能力，拓展职业发展空间。

zh-HK.text:heroTitle:h1::0: 把長期主義，變成你的職業可能。
zh-HK.text:view-home:p:hero-lead:0: 從城市空間到商業服務，我們為願意持續成長的人，提供多元業務、真實項目和清晰的長期發展通道。
zh-HK.text:benefits:p::2: 舉辦多元體驗活動，並提供心理健康相關培訓。
zh-HK.text:benefits:p::3: 提供全面醫療保障、年度醫療津貼及 Wellness Dollars，讓員工按個人需要選擇健康方案。
zh-HK.text:benefits:p::4: 籌辦各類具意義的公益項目。
zh-HK.text:benefits:p::5: 提供進修資助及考試支援，協助員工持續進修。
zh-HK.text:benefits:p::6: 透過 HiPo 計劃及一系列內部學習與發展課程，支持員工的長期職業發展。
zh-HK.text:benefits:p::7: 實地參觀住宅項目、零售地標及文化景點。
zh-HK.text:stories:span::2: 項目工程師，啟德體育園
zh-HK.text:stories:blockquote::0: 「作為退役運動員，我曾經擔心轉行。集團的運動員職業發展計劃給了我機會，團隊同事引導我學習建造的基礎知識。我在體育生涯中培養的堅毅精神在此備受重視，讓我可以在全新的職業中發光發亮。」
zh-HK.text:stories:blockquote::1: 「入職首年，我便有機會參與文化策展項目。集團鼓勵大膽構思，即使尚未完善的方案也會一起打磨，初級同事的意見同樣會被聆聽。」
zh-HK.text:stories:blockquote::2: 「當項目遇上阻礙，我們的首要任務是解決問題，而非互相指責。我在十二年間由前線員工逐步晉升，並獲得多個不同項目的發展機會。」
zh-HK.text:growth:p::2: 新世界發展為在學學生、應屆畢業生及在職員工提供系統化的職業發展路徑。我們的培育體系聚焦跨境實踐歷練、專業能力提升及領導力培育，覆蓋香港及大灣區。
zh-HK.text:growth:p::3: 我們為應屆畢業生提供系統化的領導力培訓與導師輔導。參與者可累積跨部門項目實戰經驗，為未來擔任管理職位奠定穩固基礎。
zh-HK.text:growth:p::4: 我們的實習項目提供真實職場歷練與專業指導。學生能在實際商業項目中鍛煉實操能力，並建立行業認知。
zh-HK.text:growth:p::5: 我們支持員工持續發展事業，定期舉辦研習課程並提供技能提升資源，協助人才增強綜合能力，開拓更廣闊的職業發展空間。

en.text:heroTitle:h1::0: Turn long-term thinking into your career possibilities.
en.text:view-home:p:hero-lead:0: From urban spaces to everyday services, we offer people who want to keep growing a breadth of businesses, real projects, and a clear long-term path.
en.text:benefits:p::2: We deliver a range of experiential activities and provide mental health-related training.
en.text:benefits:p::3: Comprehensive medical coverage, annual medical allowances, and Wellness Dollars that support personalised health choices.
en.text:benefits:p::4: We organise a wide range of meaningful community and charitable initiatives.
en.text:benefits:p::5: Education subsidies and examination support help employees pursue further learning.
en.text:benefits:p::6: Our HiPo programme and a suite of in-house learning and development initiatives support long-term career progression.
en.text:benefits:p::7: Site visits to residential developments, retail destinations, and cultural landmarks.
en.text:stories:span::2: Project Engineer, Kai Tak Sports Park
en.text:stories:blockquote::0: “As a former athlete, I was initially concerned about changing industries. The Group’s athlete career programme gave me an opportunity, and my teammates helped me learn the fundamentals of construction. The perseverance I developed through sport is valued here, allowing me to build a rewarding new career.”
en.text:stories:blockquote::1: “Within my first year, I had the opportunity to work on cultural curation projects. The Group encourages bold ideas, and even unfinished proposals are refined together. Junior voices are genuinely heard.”
en.text:stories:blockquote::2: “When projects encounter obstacles, our priority is to solve problems rather than assign blame. Over twelve years, I progressed from a frontline role and gained opportunities to work across a range of projects.”
en.text:growth:p::2: New World Development provides structured career pathways for students, recent graduates, and current employees. Our talent development framework focuses on cross-border practical experience, professional capability building, and leadership development across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.
en.text:growth:p::3: We provide recent graduates with structured leadership training and mentorship. Participants gain hands-on experience across departmental projects, building a strong foundation for future management roles.
en.text:growth:p::4: Our internship programme provides real-world work experience and professional guidance. Students develop practical skills through live business projects and build a clear understanding of the industry.
en.text:growth:p::5: We support our people in building lasting careers through regular learning programmes and skill-building resources that strengthen well-rounded capabilities and open up new opportunities.
